summary.value: Channel your negativity into an otherworldly attack.

system.description: Channel your negativity into an otherworldly attack. You may immediately perform a free attack with a melee weapon you have equipped. If you have two weapons equipped, you must use the one equipped in your off-hand slot. This attack may target creatures that you cannot see. If you used a weapon belonging to the arcane, dagger, or flail Category for this attack, it deals extra damage equal to (the total number of Inferiority, Mistrust, and/or Hatred emotions among your Bonds).
